label: PF Backlog 204
title: EPIC: Pluggable/modular core + industry-standards adoption (MCP, A2A, AG-UI, OTel)
body:
## Problem / why
The harness should be pluggable/modular - scalable and adaptable to env/user needs - and interoperable
with the emerging industry standards (MCP for tools, A2A for agents, AG-UI for frontends, OpenTelemetry
GenAI for observability). Today it is a capable but implicit monolith with bespoke protocols.

## Goal & value
Everything variable is a plugin behind a port; the core depends only on ports. Adopt the open standards
so we interop with the ecosystem while KEEPING our differentiators (governed product pipeline).
See docs/architecture-pluggable-modular.md.

## In scope (sub-items)
- BI-0196 adopt MCP (expose tools; consume external MCP servers)
- BI-0197 adopt A2A (agent<->agent interop)
- BI-0198 AG-UI event stream for the dashboard (typed run/tool/message events)
- BI-0199 OpenTelemetry GenAI observability (spans incl. multimodal prompts/responses)
- BI-0200 plugin/registry framework (ports+adapters: providers/tools/agents/stages/validators)

## Out of scope
- Media generators/adapters (BI-0188/BI-0193); capability packs (BI-0189).

## Acceptance criteria
- A new provider/tool/agent/stage can be added via a registry entry + adapter, no core edit.
- MCP and A2A endpoints exposed; OTel spans emitted for a run; AG-UI stream drives a client.

analysis.implementation_strategy: EPIC over BI-0196..BI-0200. Formalize the plugin/registry framework (BI-0200) as ports+adapters on top of existing `core/mcp.py`, `core/a2a.py`, `core/otel.py`; register via `config/mcp-servers.json`, `config/a2a-remotes.json`. BI-0196 wraps existing tools as MCP + consumes external servers; BI-0197 A2A agent interop over `core/a2a.py`; BI-0198 AG-UI typed event stream for dashboard; BI-0199 OTel GenAI spans extending `core/otel.py`. Core depends only on ports; no bespoke protocol edits after.
dependency_findings: BLOCKS BI-0218 (observability layer needs OTel GenAI, BI-0199)
REQUIRES sub-items BI-0196..BI-0200 for epic completion
RELATED BI-0188/BI-0193 (media adapters as first registry consumers), BI-0189 (packs as registry kind)
conflict_findings: `core/otel.py` also consumed by BI-0218 - BI-0218 must not re-implement spans
`config/model-catalog.json` / provider registries shared with BI-0185/BI-0218 - registry schema ownership must be settled here
Dashboard event stream (BI-0198) touches UI surfaces owned by BI-0134 work
duplication_findings: `core/mcp.py`, `core/a2a.py`, `core/otel.py` + configs already exist - adopt/extend, do not write new protocol layers
BI-0189 capability-pack registry overlaps plugin registry - define pack registry as a registry kind, not a second framework
BI-0218 observability panel reuses BI-0199 spans - single span emitter
analysis.rationale: Strong reuse: all four standards have existing modules and configs; the epic mostly formalizes them behind ports with the registry as the one genuinely new component.
assumptions: docs/architecture-pluggable-modular.md defines the target ports+adapters layout
Existing mcp.py/a2a.py/otel.py are functional starting points, not throwaway
Differentiators (governed product pipeline) remain untouched by adapters
risks: Standards (MCP/A2A/AG-UI) are evolving; API churn risk
Over-abstraction into ports could destabilize working bespoke paths during migration
A2A adoption may require protocol negotiation features not yet needed
evidence: Candidate code lists core/mcp.py, core/a2a.py, core/otel.py and both config JSONs
Sub-item titles BI-0196..BI-0200 enumerate the standards work
BI-0218 body lists OTel GenAI (BI-0199) as a dependency, confirming upstream need
